articles.title: TRUMP SEALED DEAL FOR NVIDIA TO REHIRE JENSEN HUANG AS CEO
articles.summary: President Trump made a personal promise that Jensen Huang had not broken national security laws. The sharp stock price drop after his resignation and questions about the leadership of the interim CEO also spurred the board's decision. Nvidia's newly appointed board chair had previously stated that the board did not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO. Trump believes his administration's close working relationship with Huang gives the US its best opportunity to protect national security and prevent cutting-edge AI chips from reaching banned customers.

articles.title: OPENAI STAFFER LIKELY CAPTURED SECRETS ON HIDDEN BUG, US SAYS
articles.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former engineer at OpenAI, has pleaded not guilty to an eavesdropping charge for bugging an office conference room, likely to intercept trade secrets. He has requested bail, but there are concerns that he may try to flee before trial given his relatively weak ties to the US and the considerable resources and connections he has to Saudi Arabia. The government has so far located hundreds of audio files on Alfozan's computer, many of which involve discussions of what may be trade secrets. He appears to have uploaded at least some of the recordings to Dropbox.

articles.title: TESLA FSD V15 IS AI4'S LAST SHOT AS MUSK REVEALS HOW LITTLE COMPUTE IS LEFT
articles.summary: Tesla's FSD v15 is the company's last real shot at delivering unsupervised self-driving on the AI4 computer. The next-gen A15 chip will not be coming to cars, and the mid-cycle AI4.5 upgrade had its RAM cut from 32GB to 24GB. The mid-cycle refresh exists mainly because Tesla needs a new memory type it can actually buy. The cost of the AI4 chip is now twice as much due to memory and storage price hikes.

articles.title: THE INCREDIBLE, ELEGANT DNA REPAIR SYSTEM MAKES GENE EDITING WORK
articles.summary: Cells have a native repair mechanism for DNA that recognizes and replaces faulty DNA before lasting damage or dysfunction can set in. This ability evolved essentially at the same time as DNA, as it is impossible to have stable genetic information without DNA repair. The mechanisms are essential to the evolutionary lineage of all known life. Scientists and doctors experimenting with gene editing use these natural self-editing and repair tools to insert, delete, or mutate genes to study and treat disease.

articles.title: WATCHING USERS IS HOW YOU MAKE PRODUCTS BETTER
articles.summary: Observing someone try to use your product is humbling and often excruciating. Watching a real user do realistic tasks will reveal problems you would have never guessed at, no matter how much careful thought you put into it. Some people have great difficulty acknowledging that the thing they helped make is the problem. Being afraid of feedback is a surefire way to create bad products.

articles.title: LADYBIRD WEB BROWSER/ENGINE REACHES ALPHA
articles.summary: The Ladybird open source desktop web browser was built from scratch with its own independent web engine. After four years of dedicated development, it has now entered its alpha phase. Usability is still modest, but the browser is functional. Some websites will still crash. The alpha build is available for macOS and Linux.
